evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Opposed concepts ('Owned intelligence' vs 'rented intelligence') placed in deliberate contrast within a single declarative sentence.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Balanced parallel clauses ('The substrate is X; the perspective is Y') forming an antithetical contrast between commodity and enduring asset.
